evidence: STATUS_BY_KIND maps DomainErrorKind values to HTTP status codes (400/404/409), which is HTTP transport mapping and belongs in infrastructure.
errorMiddleware(err, _req, res, _next) uses res.status(...).json(...) to send Express responses, which is transport logic.
clientStatusOf checks the 4xx status Express sets on malformed-JSON errors. This is framework-specific handling.
notFoundMiddleware returns a 404 for routes that don't exist. This is routing and transport behaviour.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is Express error-handling middleware in the infrastructure layer. Everything it does belongs to the transport layer. It maps domain error kinds to HTTP status codes, handles request-parsing errors and Express's malformed-JSON errors, logs unexpected errors and sends 500 and 404 JSON responses. It contains no business rules: it only turns errors into HTTP responses. It does not decide when a domain error happens. All of this fits the infrastructure layer's role.
